GAF4 key, indexed by file offset modulo keylen - 1

drops the voice flag when voice_exists fails
saved with the system data; set by op 0x99
bit n-1 = CG n seen; set by op 0x9d and 0x55
script opcode 0x15: goto a label of any script, in the current local scene
script opcode 0x22: gosub (a label marked as a scene enters a new local scene)
script opcode 0x36: chapter start (name in the scene and in chapter_name)
script opcode 0x37: chapter end; inside a chapter jumps to its end point
the step every handler ends with: the next record's handler
next_instruction for a caller that passes the task in EAX
SkipText.cpp: marks a text as read
loads HD/CDFiles/<n>.cd; touches no screen object
loads the script if another one, then sets the position
gosub and link target: pushes the call stack, or for a scene label a new local scene (enter_local_scene)
makes a new local scene current (current_scene)
the local scene: chapter name +4, script id +0x3c, environment objects +0x28c
op 0x8c: adds an environment module to current_scene + 0x28c
Animation-RandomNoise: opacity begin -> end over time, then held (mode bit 0x10 would end it)
script opcode 0x93: unlocks a scene of the scene replay
script opcode 0x94: end of a replayable scene
